text: Free money made people work more.
A California city gave people five hundred dollars a month. Full-time jobs jumped from twenty-eight percent... to forty.
Now Elon Musk says he'll give every kid in America a SpaceX share. That's seventy-two million kids.
So... will they grow up lazy?
Alaska already ran this test. Since nineteen eighty-two, almost everyone there, even babies, gets a yearly oil check.
In twenty twenty-two, it hit over three thousand dollars each.
Economists checked. Jobs didn't drop. Part-time work went up.
Turns out a cushion doesn't make people quit. It gives them room to find better work.
So the real question isn't if these kids get lazy. It's what they'll build.
